game.name: Lollipop Chainsaw (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Ru)
game.desc: The game follows the adventures of Juliet Starling, a San Romero High School cheerleader who got caught in a zombie outbreak led by a Goth student and five zombie overlords representing types of music; Equipped with a chainsaw, Juliet must use her cheerleading abilities and charm to survive.
